race.comment: CINDERSEA (7) went fast in front and tried hard but found a couple better when resuming over 1110m at Doomben last start. Won't mind the extra trip with that run under the belt. Should control things in front and it will take a good effort to run her down. KINGDOM UNDERSIEGE (13) raced handy and looked to have every chance but disappointed over this distance at Ipswich last time out. Has a habit of mixing his form but his only visit here over this trip resulted in a soft win. Can take this out without surprising. SWIFTIES (14) just got the bob in to collect a Class 3 here at this distance recently when third-up. Up in grade but drops sharply in the weights and has improvement to come. SIR CARTER (11) was brave in defeat at Dalby last time. Goes fast and should be thereabouts when the judge calls a halt. DANCE GAVIN DANCE (12) has been airborne of late - the last 100m might be what brings him undone.
